evaluations.evidence: using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Prescribes a concrete technical mechanism (fingerprinting) rather than stating the stakeholder need.
Specifies the desired basis for search (profile) without prescribing an implementation mechanism.
Describes the desired source of recommendations (other similar users) but does not mandate a specific algorithm or technical solution.
Asks for finding similar content based on content similarity without prescribing how similarity must be computed.

evaluations.evidence: by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Specifies particular data sources/implementation (metadata and image tags) as the means to achieve the need.

evaluations.evidence: have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Mandates availability of tags for processing, prescribing storage/processing requirements rather than stating the underlying need.
Requests the ability to view thumbnail sequences (a user need) without prescribing UI widgets or implementation details.
Seeks information about similar items, stated as a requirement without specifying how to implement it.
Asks for info about perceptually similar items; describes the need without mandating a technical approach.
Requests recommendations from similar profiles; this specifies intent but not an implementation detail.
Wants recommendations based on relevant news events in the area; describes the desired basis but does not prescribe a specific technical solution.
States the need to identify persons and receive related info; this is a functional need rather than an imposed implementation detail.
Requests product identification and related info without prescribing how identification must be implemented.
Asks to identify broadcaster logos and receive related info; describes need, not a solution.
Requests identification of brands and related info without mandating an implementation approach.
Allows taking/uploading an image to get related video recommendations; it states the user's goal rather than a technical solution.

evaluations.evidence: access content using a geographical map
evaluations.rationale: Prescribes a concrete UI mechanism (geographical map) for accessing content instead of stating the underlying user need.

evaluations.evidence: using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: Specifies a particular technical mechanism (automatic speech recognition) rather than the stakeholder need to search by spoken content.
Describes admin capabilities to see, validate and edit segmentation; this is a stakeholder need without implementation details.
Requests annotation and topic extraction per segment; states the desired outcome without prescribing algorithms.
Asks to filter and rank by A/V quality aspects; this defines the goal without mandating a specific technical approach.
Wants a quick assessment whether audio has been edited; expresses the requirement but does not prescribe the detection method.
Requests prefiltering of nudity content as a need; does not prescribe how that filtering must be implemented.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Specifies a particular filtering/search mechanism (using low-level asset information) rather than stating the need abstractly.

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Mandates automatic validation (an implementation choice) instead of describing the stakeholder need at a problem level.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter the content using search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags either recognized by the system of provided by the user
evaluations.rationale: Specifies concrete data sources and method (search on metadata/tags) as the solution rather than the need.

evaluations.evidence: based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk
evaluations.rationale: Prescribes specific mechanisms/sources (automated analysis and particular data sources) for the assessment, pushing implementation details into the story.
Asks to detect when to prompt a scientist based on annotations/Talk info; it defines trigger conditions but does not mandate a particular technical implementation.
Requests identification of volunteer types as a stakeholder need without prescribing how to do it.

evaluations.evidence: using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: Explicitly prescribes an algorithmic/technical approach (low-level image features) for preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect
evaluations.rationale: Requires automatic detection (implementation approach) rather than stating the high-level need without implementation details.

evaluations.evidence: automatic image series detection
evaluations.rationale: Prescribes an automatic detection mechanism as the means to handle timestamp malfunctions, i.e., implementation detail.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal species preclassification
evaluations.rationale: Specifies an automatic preclassification mechanism (algorithmic approach) rather than stating the need abstractly.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal attribute preclassification
evaluations.rationale: Mandates automatic preclassification (implementation/algorithmic choice) instead of expressing the stakeholder need.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal number detection
evaluations.rationale: Specifies an automatic detection mechanism (implementation detail) rather than the high-level need.

evaluations.evidence: automatic segmentation or localization of plankton
evaluations.rationale: Prescribes automatic segmentation/localization (technical approach) rather than stating the problem at a higher level.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton
evaluations.rationale: Requires automatic detection (an implementation choice) instead of focusing on the stakeholder need.

evaluations.evidence: automatic detection of plankton size or orientation
evaluations.rationale: Specifies automatic detection (algorithmic/technical mechanism) rather than stating the need abstractly.

evaluations.evidence: automatic preclassification of plankton species
evaluations.rationale: Mandates automatic preclassification (implementation detail) instead of expressing the stakeholder need only.

evaluations.evidence: automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration
evaluations.rationale: Specifies an automatic analysis approach (technical mechanism) to achieve the need rather than stating the need neutrally.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect the time ... where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Requires automatic detection (implementation choice) instead of defining the requirement without prescribing how to detect it.
Requests detection of important features in satellite images; this states the need without prescribing a specific technical method.
Wants to assess probability/weight of classifications based on experience; describes a desired basis for assessment rather than mandating a specific algorithm.
Requests prefiltering to remove artifacts; this is a functional need without prescribing the implementation.
Asks to detect moving and transient objects; specifies functionality without imposing a particular technical solution.
Requests removal of background noise and distracting sounds; describes the desired outcome without specifying how to achieve it.
Asks to group similar whale calls; states the need without mandating a grouping algorithm.
Requests identification of the number of whales in an audio file; a functional requirement not specifying implementation details.
Wants to know when to interrupt a volunteer; expresses a decision-making need rather than prescribing a mechanism.
Asks whether to interrupt with text, image, or video; specifies preferred modalities but does not mandate a technical implementation, so it's still problem-oriented.
Requests knowing when to educate a volunteer; a stakeholder need without implementation detail.
Asks whether to educate with text, image, or video; specifies modality preference but not an implementation mechanism.
Wants to know which educational piece to give; a decision-oriented requirement rather than a technical prescription.
Requests detection of interesting volunteer comments; describes the need without prescribing an algorithm.
Asks to know when Zoonibot should comment; a behavioral requirement rather than an implementation detail.
Requests knowing when Zoonibot should give an explanation; expresses intended behavior without specifying how to implement it.
Wants to know what Zoonibot should say; this is content/behavior specification, not a technical solution prescription.
Requests grouping subjects by similarity; states the desired capability without enforcing implementation details.
Asks to recommend projects based on previous experiences; describes the recommendation goal without prescribing an algorithm.
Requests a summary of articles for reuse; this specifies the stakeholder need without mandating a specific technical method.
